title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - Storage
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/Storage. storage device which is the main component of Fill Rate Based Control type.). In the context of flexibility control and instructuons, a device shall be able to inform the CEM about its fill level, a measure of how full the storage is, and the lower and upper boundaries that the fill level should remain within. Subclass of Thing (http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Thing, not itself translated in this candidate). Subclass of Device per the SAREF4ENER ontology; inherited properties are documented on the Device model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Storage'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

fillRate.description: Relationship. Indicates the change in fill_level per second. The lower_boundary of the NumberRange is associated with an operation_mode_factor of 0, the upper_boundary is associated with an operation_mode_factor of 1. Relationship to NumberRange.

hasFillLevelRange.description: Relationship. The range of the fill level for which this FRBC.OperationModeElement applies. If this concept is applied on a Storage it indicated the range in which a storage should remain. Relationship to NumberRange.

hasFillLevelTargetProfile.description: Relationship. The Fill Level Target Profile of the storage that the current Fill Rate Profile tries to accomodate for. NB. This cannot be modelled as a TimeSeries, since the x-axis is not time. Relationship to FillLevelTargetProfile.

hasLeakageBehaviour.description: Relationship. The Leakage Behaviour associated with this storage. Relationship to LeakageBehaviour.

unitCode.description: Unit of measure code (UN/CEFACT common code where applicable).

presentFillLevel.description: Property. A saref:PropertyValue with a percentage value indicating the fill level of the storage. Models saref:PropertyValue (core SAREF, not itself translated in this candidate): a value with its unit of measure.
